entries.text: Enabled Zcash Ironwood support by default. (#56872)
Updated wallet to reject incorrect Zcash account birthday height. (#58757)
Updated wallet to reject negative Zcash "Send" amounts before review. (#58755)
Added Zcash Ironwood migration banner. (#58493)
Added the ability to "Reset account birthday" for Zcash Shielded account. (#55611)
Fixed issue where transactions could be stuck in pending state in certain cases. (#56490)
Updated Zcash library to 0.14. (#56404)
Updated Zcash to work in multiple profiles. (#44991 & #55374)
Added an "Unshield funds" button on the token menu. (#53718)
Added support for "NEAR Intents" swap provider via "Gate3". (#51720)
Added "Bridge" buttons for BTC, ZEC and ADA. (#52555)
Added "SafeSign" for "Gate3" swaps. (#51936)
Implemented status checks for "Gate3" swaps. (#52229)
Fixed clicking on the Zcash address loading the transaction page instead of address page on the block explorer. (#51964)
Added support for Zcash deshielding (Shielded -> Transparent) transactions. (#45875)
Fixed unnecessary "Shield" and "Unshield" warnings. (#51762)
Fixed missing "Memo" field on the "Confirm Send" screen for Zcash. (#52303)
Added support for Zcash Testnet. (#50116)
Fixed token visibility changes between the "Portfolio" page and panel views. (#51540)
Fixed issue where disabling the Zcash flag disabled Cardano account creation in the "Create Account" modal. (#50001)
Updated UI for "Confirm Send" panel. (#49235)
Updated "Confirm Shield" panel UI for ZEC Shield transactions. (#49621)
Fixed issue where Zcash Transparent address was the only address copied on the "Deposit" screen. (#49978)
Added a "Shield Funds" button to the token list item dropdown for ZEC tokens. (#46596)
Added a "Shield Account" alert on the "Account Details" panel for Zcash accounts. (#46598)
Added a Brave proxy for Zcash mainnet endpoint. (#46266)
Removed the "Edit" gas button for Zcash transactions. (#45748)
Added "Reset ZCash sync state" setting under brave://settings/web3. (#44782)
Added Zcash shielded support on the "Deposit" screen. (#45185)
Fixed issue where Zcash native token may not be displayed on some wallets. (#46306)
Fixed missing header for BTC and Zcash on the "Deposit" screen. (#41315)
Added Zcash shielded support. (#44432)
Added "Out of sync" alert and "Sync Account Status" warning to allow users to sync their shielded Zcash account. (#42851)
Fixed casing for Zcash on the "Accounts" page. (#43278)
Added Zcash "Deposit" modal. (#42221)
Added "Shielded" label to all shielded ZEC tokens in Brave Wallet. (#42285)
Added a "Memo" field to the Zcash transaction's "Confirm Transaction" screen. (#42078)
Added a "Memo" field to the Zcash transaction's "Send" screen. (#41986)
Added support for BTC Ledger hardware accounts. (#38447)
Implemented ZCash Shielded account modal. (#41780)
Fixed "Send" transactions not working for transparent address in certain scenarios. (#42951)
Fixed ZCash balance resolution issue. (#40635)
Added "View on block explorer" option to the "Account Details" menu. (#39655)
Added a loading spinner to the "Select account" prompt when address is being generated for BTC or ZCash. (#38931)
Improved display of ZEC addresses and additional details when using dark theme. (#35827)
Fixed panel crash which occurred when attempting to lookup EIP1159 estimates for non EVM or FIL transactions. (#38970)
Added the ability to import BTC accounts (BIP84) into Brave Wallet. (#38446)
Updated ZCash endpoint URL. (#38782)

Removed "Export" option for both Zcash and BTC accounts. (#35849)
